decisionsTitle: Per elite, «Apare în clasament» and «Apare pe site»: hors concours in the results, «Elitele cursei» on the event page, and a staff tick that only hides
decisionsSection:
**The owner, 2026-11-04:** «per elite, two ticks: „Apare în clasament” and „Apare pe site”». The race's elites are of two kinds — the separate list's names, printed on a bib and never registrations (§895), and registrations an Administrator marked «Elită» (§897) — and the club wants, for each of them, whether the result counts in the ranking and whether the name is shown on the site.

**Decision.**

- **Storage** (migration `0191_elite_visibility`, expand only). On the elite list's lines, `event_elite_entries.in_results` (not null, true by default: every line ranks as before) and `on_site` (not null, **false** by default: nobody on the list is shown until the club ticks it). On a registration, the club's two ticks stored as **what they hide**: `registrations.elite_hidden_from_results` and `elite_hidden_from_site`, both false by default, read only while `elite` is true — the mark taken off leaves them inert, the mark put back finds them as they were. There is no column with which a staff member could show a registered person: ticked is no override at all.
- **«Apare în clasament»** (ticked by default). Unticked, the elite runs **hors concours**: its result stays on «Clasament», its line marked «în afara clasamentului» where the place would be (and «Pe site: nu apare — elită în afara clasamentului» under it), and in the club's CSV the same words in the position column; it is **not a row** of the published results — not a name, not «Participant #bib», not a time — and it is **in nobody's position**: overall, by sex and by category the others are ranked as if it had not run (`ranking.ts`: a row `outOfRanking` is placed nowhere and keeps its category). The stored positions are ranked again **in the tick's own transaction** (`rerankEventResults`), and every read ranks from the live answers with the same rule, so the page, the public results, the podium and the file agree. A mark put on or taken off, a line deleted, or a number added to a line ranks them again too.
- **Which stored row is an elite's** — the results module's own link, nothing guessed beyond it (`results/domain/hors-concours.ts`): (1) a row filed under a registration is that registration's; (2) a typed row whose number a **confirmed** registration holds is that runner's, as «Clasament» draws it — never an elite line's; (3) any other typed row is a separate-list elite's when its number is **a line's number** — a number is one person's at a race (§895), so this is exact; (4) for a line **with no number** only, the one typed row whose name is the line's name, both folded as the list stores a name (spaces trimmed and collapsed) and compared without case or diacritics, and only when **exactly one** typed row of the race — whose number is no line's — carries it: two rows with that name match neither, because leaving a stranger out of the ranking would take their place from them — a line with a number is matched exactly.
- **«Apare pe site»** on a line of the separate list (unticked by default). Ticked — only with the person's agreement: the card says so under the ticks, and ticking it asks first, naming the person («Arăți numele pe pagina evenimentului?») — the name and the line's number are shown in a small block **«Elitele cursei»** right under the «Cine vine» fold, in the order typed, with one line saying they are elite runners invited by the club, shown with their agreement, not registrations and not counted above. **A block of its own, not «Elită» rows of the «Cine vine» table**: the table's rows are registrations in the confirmed order with a position, and its title and summary line count them — a list line has no state, no place and no position, and a row among them would read as one nobody holds. Drawn by `StartList` itself, so it has exactly the list's gates: the event's public list on (`NAMES`), its period not over (§421), the database reachable, and the names inside the list's `data-nosnippet` section. Read through `cachedPublicEliteEntries`, filed under «places» and «events» and so with no saved copy (a name taken off must not outlive it, §281); `listPublicEliteEntries` selects the name and the number and nothing else (`tests/privacy/public-surface.test.ts`).
- **«Apare pe site» on a registered elite only hides.** Unticked, the public list and the published results read the registration as one that did not tick «Vreau să apar pe lista de participanți & rezultate» — the one tick that covers both (§143, §570): a «Participant (nume ascuns)» row and count while confirmed, no row and no count while pending or waiting (§396), «Participant #bib» in the results while it still ranks (`repository.ts#namedOnPublicList`, `results.ts#tickedForTheSite`). Ticked — the default — the person's own ticks decide exactly as before the mark: a runner who did not tick is never named, whatever the club ticks. A registered elite is not repeated under «Elitele cursei»: being an elite is not something they agreed to have announced.
- **Where, and who.** The two ticks sit on every line of the elite card («Elită — doar numele pe BIB», the list's names and the marked registrations), as the house's `TickButton` posting a small form beside the event's save form (`setEliteEntryTickAction`, `setRegisteredEliteTickAction`); on a marked registration's «⋮» in the registrations list, under «Nu mai e elită», as two tick items (`menuitemcheckbox`, the box glyph, the setting's words whatever its state — never a toggle verb; `setRegistrationEliteTickAction`, back to the list as it stood); and on the registration's own page, a card «Elită: clasament și site» drawn while it is marked. Under the ticks one sentence is said — on the card «Bifează „Apare pe site” doar cu acordul persoanei», on the registration's page that the club's ticks only hide — and what each tick does sits behind the «?» beside it (§511); in the «⋮» each tick says it in its tooltip. The Administrator's alone (`canManageRegistrations`), asserted at each action's door and again in `elite-list.ts#setEliteEntryTick` / `elite-mark.ts#setRegistrationEliteTick` (BR-REQ-060-01); the Organizer sees the same boxes, disabled; Tehnic sees neither the card nor the list. A registration no longer marked is refused in its own words (`ELITE_NOT_MARKED`). Only putting a name on the site asks; «Apare în clasament» and every hide ask nothing (§384: they tell nobody and the same tick undoes them).
- **The trail**, ids and the new value only, never a name or a number: `event_elite.in_results` / `out_of_results` / `on_site` / `off_site` on the event with `{ entryId, inResults }` or `{ entryId, onSite }`, and `registration.elite_in_results` / `elite_out_of_results` / `elite_on_site` / `elite_off_site` on the registration with `{ inResults }` or `{ onSite }`, shown in its timeline. A press that finds the tick as asked writes nothing; the public pages are told after the commit, only when something changed.
- **The event's JSON file** carries neither the list nor its ticks, and brings neither in: §895 keeps the people's names out of it, a file carrying an elite list is refused as any key this release does not know is, and an import over an event leaves its lines and their two ticks exactly as they were — a test holds each way.
- **The rule documents** say it where the public list and the staff verbs are written: CLAUDE.md's public-list row and staff row, `AGENTS.md` §10.10 (the published set, and a bullet for the race's elites) and §15.11 (the ticks beside the elite mark).

**Refused.**

- **Showing a registered person without their consent** — a staff «Apare pe site» that would put a registered elite's name on «Cine vine», in the results or under «Elitele cursei» when their own tick says no. The list's names are a disclosure the person chooses (§32, §143); the club's tick may only take a name away.
- **«Elită» rows inside the «Cine vine» table** — they would be positions nobody holds and numbers the title and the line above do not count.
- **Matching a numberless line's result by a guess** — initials, a similar spelling, the first of two equal names: a wrong match takes a stranger's place in the ranking.
- **Deleting or moving the result of an elite out of the ranking** — the club keeps its own record of the time; only what the public sees and how the others are placed change.
changelogLine: - **An elite's «Apare în clasament» and «Apare pe site»** — two ticks of the Administrator's on every elite: on the elite card, the registrations list's «⋮» and the registration's page. Unticked, «Apare în clasament» runs the elite hors concours — off the public results and out of everybody's places, still on «Clasament» marked «în afara clasamentului»; a name of the elite list ticked «Apare pe site», with the person's agreement, shows under «Elitele cursei» on the event page while its list is on; on a registered elite the tick only hides. §NNN.

specsCriteria.text: Given a race with results, when an Administrator unticks «Apare în clasament» on an elite — a line of the race's elite list or a registration marked «Elită» — then its result stays on «Clasament», marked «în afara clasamentului» where the place would be and in the club's CSV with those words in the position column, it is no row of the published results, and every other runner's positions — overall, by sex and by category — are the ones they would have without it, stored in the same transaction and read alike; the result is recognised by its registration, by the confirmed registration holding a typed row's number, by the line's number, or, for a line with no number, by its name (spaces, case and diacritics folded) on exactly one typed row — two rows with that name leave both ranked; ticking it again, deleting the line or taking the mark off ranks it again. Verification: unit `results/hors-concours.test.ts`, `results/typed-line-recall.test.ts`, `results/csv-and-words.test.ts`, integration `results/elite-hors-concours.test.ts` (2026-11-04, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Given an event whose public list is on, when an Administrator ticks «Apare pe site» on a line of the race's elite list — asked first, naming the person, the card saying it is ticked only with their agreement — then «Elitele cursei», under the «Cine vine» fold, names it with the line's number and nothing else, in the order typed, never as a row, a count or a position of the list; unticked (the default), or with the event's list off, nothing of it is shown; the event's JSON file carries neither the list nor its ticks, a file carrying one is refused, and an import over the event leaves its lines and their ticks as they were. Verification: integration `registrations/elite-visibility.test.ts`, `events/event-json.test.ts`, privacy `public-surface.test.ts` (2026-11-04, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Given a registration marked «Elită», when an Administrator unticks its «Apare pe site», then the public list and the published results read it as one that did not tick «Vreau să apar pe lista de participanți & rezultate» — a «Participant (nume ascuns)» row and count while confirmed, no row and no count while pending or waiting, «Participant #bib» in the results while it still ranks — and ticked, the person's own ticks decide: a runner who did not tick is never named, and with the mark taken off the club's tick changes nothing. Verification: integration `registrations/elite-visibility.test.ts`, `results/elite-hors-concours.test.ts`, privacy `public-surface.test.ts` (2026-11-04, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Given an elite's two ticks — on the elite card's lines, the registrations list's «⋮» and the registration's page — then only an Administrator changes them, refused for every other role at each Server Action's door and again in the service, the Organizer seeing them as disabled ticks and Tehnic refused even the read; a registration no longer marked is refused in its own words; each change leaves one audit row — `event_elite.in_results`, `out_of_results`, `on_site` or `off_site` with the line's id, `registration.elite_in_results`, `elite_out_of_results`, `elite_on_site` or `elite_off_site` on the registration — with the new value only, never a name or a number, and a press that finds the tick as asked writes nothing. Verification: integration `registrations/elite-visibility.test.ts`, `registrations/elite-mark-screens.test.ts`, `results/elite-hors-concours.test.ts`, unit `content/bib-print-card.test.ts`, `shared/confirmed-actions.test.ts` (2026-11-04, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).
